description: Shared authority creates visible uptake accountability and implementation pathways.
Public participation directly shapes resource allocation and implementation tracking.
Technology assessment can influence regulation procurement audit and rights remedies.
Community foresight influences local adaptation planning when agencies commit to follow-through.
Formal recommendations receive public institutional response but budget authority may vary.
Youth voice informs policy but often lacks binding response and budget influence.
Digital participation can gather input but may struggle to demonstrate decision influence.
Input is summarized but decision influence and remedy are weak.
